changes.summary: Made the geometry Candidate installable with a bounded signed image-to-GLB entrypoint while retaining physical Spark qualification as pending.
Pinned official Step1X source cb5ac944, PyTorch 2.13, CUDA 13.2, and SM121-native build authority.
Eliminated the implicit BRIA download and bound the DINOv2 processor authority so execution remains offline after installation.
Marked the geometry binding non-executable pending Step1X source, native dependencies, and a GLB adapter.
Added the authoritative isolated image input contract.
Replaced the broken model-card license URL with the exact upstream Apache-2.0 license.
Initial reviewed catalog release of Step1X-3D geometry pytorch-pipeline single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
